about: Public USGS historical topographic sheets (public domain), as published in the USGS Historical Topographic Map Collection. The loop reads pixels only; each GeoTIFF's own georeference is the truth, read by the scorer and never by the loop. A case is a sheet the record names (neatline bounds as printed at the corners, graticule interval) and two scans of it: two editions, or two printings.

cases.control: two different sheets passed as editions of one: the content check finds nothing to compare, so nothing may be accepted
cases.sheet: Ithaca, NY (15') with a Princeton, NJ scan as its 'edition'

cases.note: a 1:24,000 sheet prints its graticule as edge ticks and interior crosses, not lines: the lines-only reader (graticule_lines) abstained here; the frame-and-marks reader places it

cases.control: the record's bounds are one interval off (a typo): both scans are read the same wrong way and agree with each other; the evidence cannot see a wrong record
cases.sheet: Boston Bay, MA (15') with west and east 5' too far west
